title: Faithful general
description: A frame with no clear subject, or a type no guide knows. Keep the measured global grade and do not cut anything out. When water holds a reflection of a shape above it, sharpen that mirror and lift it a little.
reason: Nothing in the frame should be cut out, so the edit stays the global grade. A water reflection, when one is there, is sharpened on its own.

subject.skip: Skip the subject. This picture has no separate body to cut out.

eyes.skip: Skip the eyes. There is no eye that should be clarified.

skin.skip: Skip skin. Skin smoothing does not belong on this picture.

sky.skip: Skip the sky. The sky is not a separate grade here.

background.skip: Skip the background. Nothing here should be blurred behind a subject.

foreground.skip: Skip the foreground. The frame is handled by the global grade.

reflection.skip: Skip the reflection when the frame has no water mirror of a shape above it.
